description: Most word clouds show you which words are big. They don't show you what people actually said, in which language, or whether they said it happily. Word Cloud by TCViz is free — every feature, no licence, no watermark. Drop in a column of words, or raw survey comments: it detects the language, removes filler words and counts the rest. Shape the cloud as a circle, an icon, your own text or your logo; colour it by value, by sentiment or with 32 palettes, 17 of them colour-blind safe. WORDS OR FREE TEXT • Words: one word or phrase per row — keywords, products, tags — sized by a measure or by how often they appear. • Text: comments, tickets, reviews. The visual splits them into words (accents, Cyrillic and CJK included), removes stopwords in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian, and detects which of those languages your text uses. • Two-word phrases ("late delivery", "customer service"), minimum word length and an exclusion list. SENTIMENT WITHOUT DAX Drag a score to Color value, choose Average, set the neutral value (5.5 for a 1–10 score). Each word takes the average score of the comments that mention it: red words come with complaints, green ones with praise. The warning icon tells you if the score is being summed instead.
